name: Patillas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green field with a yellow cross charged at the centre with a green emerald, for La Esmeralda del Sur.
history: Patillas is a beach town and municipality on the southeastern coast of Puerto Rico. The four green rectangles stand for its valleys and mountains, the golden cross for fidelity to the town's patron, the Santo Cristo de la Salud, and the emerald for the nickname La Esmeralda del Sur; the design was created by Pedro de Pedro in 1977.
